# D complex_edges_and_materials

Stress masks around thin, fuzzy, transparent, shiny, and perforated edges.

## D01 lace blouse seed

- Expected: top x1
- Difficulty: lace, holes, thin_edges
- Acceptance: Lace outline should not become a solid blob; review is acceptable if holes are hard.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a white lace long sleeve blouse laid flat on a muted gray studio background. Subject: delicate lace texture, visible scalloped edges, sleeves spread, collar and hem clear. Composition/framing: centered catalog shot with padding. Lighting/mood: soft even light. Constraints: no model, no hanger, no text, no watermark.
```

## D02 fuzzy knit sweater

- Expected: top x1
- Difficulty: fuzzy_edge, knit
- Acceptance: Sweater edges should look natural without heavy background halo.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a fuzzy mohair knit sweater laid flat on a clean white background. Subject: soft hair-like fibers visible along edges, long sleeves, ribbed hem and cuffs. Composition/framing: centered product photo, full sweater visible. Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting. Constraints: no model, no text, no watermark.
```

## D03 tulle skirt

- Expected: skirt x1
- Difficulty: translucent, tulle, soft_edge
- Acceptance: Skirt should be detected; translucent hem can be review.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a pale blue tulle midi skirt laid flat on a very light gray background. Subject: translucent layered tulle, soft airy hem, waistband visible. Composition/framing: centered product photo, full skirt visible. Lighting/mood: soft diffuse light. Constraints: no model, no text, no watermark, no other garments.
```

## D04 chain strap bag

- Expected: bag x1
- Difficulty: thin_chain, metal, bag
- Acceptance: Bag body and chain strap should remain connected or review.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a small black leather shoulder bag with a thin gold chain strap on a pure white background. Subject: chain strap fully visible, bag front facing, leather texture and metal links clear. Composition/framing: centered catalog shot with generous padding around the chain. Lighting/mood: soft studio light with controlled metal highlights. Constraints: no model, no hand, no text, no watermark.
```

## D05 running shoes with laces

- Expected: shoes x1
- Difficulty: shoe_laces, fine_detail
- Acceptance: Shoe pair preserved, laces not completely removed.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a pair of white running shoes with visible loose laces on a pure white studio background. Subject: both shoes visible, laces crossing and looping, textured sole. Composition/framing: centered product photo, full pair visible. Lighting/mood: soft even studio lighting. Constraints: no foot, no logo, no text, no watermark.
```
